citations.title: Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT
A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

claims.statement: Static and covariant holographic entanglement prescriptions relate boundary-region entropy to bulk minimal or extremal surfaces under specific assumptions.
claims.scope: leading holographic prescriptions in the cited AdS/CFT settings

claims.statement: Mixed endpoint derivatives of interval entropy define a kinematic density with an infinitesimal conditional-mutual-information interpretation.
claims.scope: the source's two-dimensional holographic interval construction

claims.statement: Integrating the associated Crofton form over intersecting geodesics reconstructs bulk curve length in the relevant geometry.
claims.scope: the cited integral-geometric normalization and reconstruction class

limitations: Entropy, entropy derivatives, conditional mutual information, Crofton measure, and length are linked but nonidentical quantities.
Regulators, state dependence, and quantum or higher-curvature corrections are outside this packet's leading treatment.
No general claim is made that increasing entropy increases ordinary physical distance.
